explanation: The AI response incorrectly identified Space Shuttle Atlantis (OV-104) instead of Endeavour (OV-105) as the shuttle with the second fewest construction milestones. Consequently, none of the expected Endeavour missions landing at Edwards Air Force Base (EAFB) were provided, and instead 13 Atlantis missions were listed.
